verses.sloka: तत् श्रुत्वा निपुणम् सर्वम् भरतः सह मन्त्रिभिः ।इन्गुदी मूलम् आगम्य राम शय्याम् अवेक्ष्य ताम् ॥२-८८-१॥
verses.transliteration: tat śrutvā nipuṇam sarvam bharataḥ saha mantribhiḥ ।ingudī mūlam āgamya rāma śayyām avekṣya tām ॥2-88-1॥

translations.english: After listening to all that Guha had said, Bharatha reached the foot of the ingudi tree accompanied by his ministers and gazing at Rama's bed, said to all his mothers the magnanimous Rama rested that night here on this ground in that crushed bed.
translations.hindi: अयोध्याकाण्ड का चोरासीवाँ सग समाप्त हुआ । ——१ प्रक १---> पञ्चाशीतितम: सग; एवमुक्तस्तु भरतो निषादाधिपतिं गुहम्‌ । प्रत्युवाच महाप्राज्ञो वाक्य हेत्वर्थसंहितम्‌

verses.sloka: अब्रवीद् जननीः सर्वा इह तेन महात्मना ।शर्वरी शयिता भूमाउ इदम् अस्य विमर्दितम् ॥२-८८-२॥
verses.transliteration: abravīd jananīḥ sarvā iha tena mahātmanā ।śarvarī śayitā bhūmāu idam asya vimarditam ॥2-88-2॥

translations.english: After listening to all that Guha had said, Bharatha reached the foot of the ingudi tree accompanied by his ministers and gazing at Rama's bed, said to all his mothers the magnanimous Rama rested that night here on this ground in that crushed bed.
translations.hindi: हे ज्येष्ठ भ्राता के. मित्र ! तुम जो अकेले ही मेरी इतनी बड़ी सेना की पहुनाई करना चाहते हो--सो यह तो निश्चय ही तुन्हारा बड़ा भारी मनोरथ हे । ( अर्थात्‌ तुम्हारे इस आदर से ही हम अपने को सत्कारित मानते हैं )

verses.sloka: महा भाग कुलीनेन महा भागेन धीमता ।जातो दशरथेन ऊर्व्याम् न रामः स्वप्तुम् अर्हति ॥२-८८-३॥
verses.transliteration: mahā bhāga kulīnena mahā bhāgena dhīmatā ।jāto daśarathena ūrvyām na rāmaḥ svaptum arhati ॥2-88-3॥

translations.english: Rama, son of highly fortunate and sagacious Dasaratha, born of a noble lineage does not deserve to rest on this naked earth.
translations.hindi: परम तेजस्त्री श्रामान्‌ भरत जी गुह से इस प्रकार भ्रष्ठ बचनों से वार्तालाप का सिलसिला आरम्भ कर, फिर बोले

verses.sloka: अजिन उत्तर सम्स्तीर्णे वर आस्तरण सम्चये ।शयित्वा पुरुष व्याघ्रः कथम् शेते मही तले ॥२-८८-४॥
verses.transliteration: ajina uttara samstīrṇe vara āstaraṇa samcaye ।śayitvā puruṣa vyāghraḥ katham śete mahī tale ॥2-88-4॥

translations.english: How could Rama, the best among men used to a bed made of a pile of excellent spreads and overspread with deer skin, sleep on the bare ground?
translations.hindi: हे निषादराज ! भला यह ता बतलाओ कि, हम किस मागं. से भरद्वाज के आश्रम को जायँ। क्योकि हम देखते हैं कि, यह. , गङ्गा का जलप्रायदेश अत्यन्त दुष्प्रवेश्य अथवा दुगेम है

verses.sloka: प्रासाद अग्र विमानेषु वलभीषु च सर्वदा ।हैम राजत भौमेषु वर आस्त्ररण शालिषु ॥२-८८-५॥
verses.transliteration: prāsāda agra vimāneṣu valabhīṣu ca sarvadā ।haima rājata bhaumeṣu vara āstraraṇa śāliṣu ॥2-88-5॥

translations.english: Rama, scorcher of enemies, one who was accostomed to dwell in the attic of sevenstoreyed mansions with floors paved with gold, and silver, spread with excellent carpets, decked with bouquets of flowers and perfumed with sandal and agaru. The peaks of those palaces were bright like towering white clouds and echoed with cries of parrots. They were cool and fragrant with perfumes. The marvellous palaces made of golden walls are comparable to mount Meru. He used to wake up to the sounds of songs and musical instruments, the tinkling of finest ornaments and the splendid sounds of the drums. Many bards, genealogists and panegyrists singing befitting ballads and extolling his virtues at appropriate time used to salute him in reverence (Bharata lamented).

verses.sloka: पुष्प सम्चय चित्रेषु चन्दन अगरु गन्धिषु ।पाण्डुर अभ्र प्रकाशेषु शुक सम्घ रुतेषु च ॥२-८८-६॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpa samcaya citreṣu candana agaru gandhiṣu ।pāṇḍura abhra prakāśeṣu śuka samgha ruteṣu ca ॥2-88-6॥

translations.english: Rama, scorcher of enemies, one who was accostomed to dwell in the attic of sevenstoreyed mansions with floors paved with gold, and silver, spread with excellent carpets, decked with bouquets of flowers and perfumed with sandal and agaru. The peaks of those palaces were bright like towering white clouds and echoed with cries of parrots. They were cool and fragrant with perfumes. The marvellous palaces made of golden walls are comparable to mount Meru. He used to wake up to the sounds of songs and musical instruments, the tinkling of finest ornaments and the splendid sounds of the drums. Many bards, genealogists and panegyrists singing befitting ballads and extolling his virtues at appropriate time used to salute him in reverence (Bharata lamented).
translations.hindi: हे महायशास्वी राजकुमार ! आप इसके लिए कुछ भी चिता न करें ! जो लोग इस प्रान्त का रत्ती-रत्ती हाल जानते हैं, वे आपकी रखबाली के लिए घनुष वाण ले, बड़ी सावधानता यूवक, आपके साथ जायंगे और मैं स्वयं भी आपके पीछे पीछे चलू गा

verses.sloka: प्रासादवरवर्येषु शीतवत्सु सुगन्धिषु ।उषित्वा मेरुकल्पेषु कृतकाम्चनभित्तिषु ॥२-८८-७॥
verses.transliteration: prāsādavaravaryeṣu śītavatsu sugandhiṣu ।uṣitvā merukalpeṣu kṛtakāmcanabhittiṣu ॥2-88-7॥

translations.english: Rama, scorcher of enemies, one who was accostomed to dwell in the attic of sevenstoreyed mansions with floors paved with gold, and silver, spread with excellent carpets, decked with bouquets of flowers and perfumed with sandal and agaru. The peaks of those palaces were bright like towering white clouds and echoed with cries of parrots. They were cool and fragrant with perfumes. The marvellous palaces made of golden walls are comparable to mount Meru. He used to wake up to the sounds of songs and musical instruments, the tinkling of finest ornaments and the splendid sounds of the drums. Many bards, genealogists and panegyrists singing befitting ballads and extolling his virtues at appropriate time used to salute him in reverence (Bharata lamented).
translations.hindi: किन्तु आपकी इस विशाल सेना को देख, मेरे मन में यह संन्देद उत्पन्न हो गया है कि कहीं आप अक्लिष्टकरसा श्रीराम के पास किसी दुष्ट अभिप्राय से तो नहीं जा रहे

verses.sloka: गीत वादित्र निर्घोषैर् वर आभरण निह्स्वनैः ।मृदन्ग वर शब्दैः च सततम् प्रतिबोधितः ॥२-८८-८॥
verses.transliteration: gīta vāditra nirghoṣair vara ābharaṇa nihsvanaiḥ ।mṛdanga vara śabdaiḥ ca satatam pratibodhitaḥ ॥2-88-8॥

translations.english: Rama, scorcher of enemies, one who was accostomed to dwell in the attic of sevenstoreyed mansions with floors paved with gold, and silver, spread with excellent carpets, decked with bouquets of flowers and perfumed with sandal and agaru. The peaks of those palaces were bright like towering white clouds and echoed with cries of parrots. They were cool and fragrant with perfumes. The marvellous palaces made of golden walls are comparable to mount Meru. He used to wake up to the sounds of songs and musical instruments, the tinkling of finest ornaments and the splendid sounds of the drums. Many bards, genealogists and panegyrists singing befitting ballads and extolling his virtues at appropriate time used to salute him in reverence (Bharata lamented).
translations.hindi: गुह के ऐसा स्पष्ट कहने पर, आकाश की तरह निमल स्वभाव क भरत जी नवाद से ( ऐसा सन्देह करने के लिए नाराज हो कर कड़े वचन नहीं बोले, प्रत्युत ) मघुर बचन बोले

verses.sloka: बन्दिभिर् वन्दितः काले बहुभिः सूत मागधैः ।गाथाभिर् अनुरूपाभिः स्तुतिभिः च परम्तपः ॥२-८८-९॥
verses.transliteration: bandibhir vanditaḥ kāle bahubhiḥ sūta māgadhaiḥ ।gāthābhir anurūpābhiḥ stutibhiḥ ca paramtapaḥ ॥2-88-9॥

translations.english: Rama, scorcher of enemies, one who was accostomed to dwell in the attic of sevenstoreyed mansions with floors paved with gold, and silver, spread with excellent carpets, decked with bouquets of flowers and perfumed with sandal and agaru. The peaks of those palaces were bright like towering white clouds and echoed with cries of parrots. They were cool and fragrant with perfumes. The marvellous palaces made of golden walls are comparable to mount Meru. He used to wake up to the sounds of songs and musical instruments, the tinkling of finest ornaments and the splendid sounds of the drums. Many bards, genealogists and panegyrists singing befitting ballads and extolling his virtues at appropriate time used to salute him in reverence (Bharata lamented).

verses.sloka: अश्रद्धेयम् इदम् लोके न सत्यम् प्रतिभाति मा ।मुह्यते खलु मे भावः स्वप्नो अयम् इति मे मतिः ॥२-८८-१०॥
verses.transliteration: aśraddheyam idam loke na satyam pratibhāti mā ।muhyate khalu me bhāvaḥ svapno ayam iti me matiḥ ॥2-88-10॥

translations.english: It is unbelievable that such a thing has happened to Rama in this world. It does not seem real to me and looks appears like a dream and my mind is bewildered.
translations.hindi: हे गुह मैं तो वनवाही रात को लौटाने के लिए जा रहा हूँ। इस सम्बन्ध में तुमको अन्यथा न समभना चाहिए । झैँ यह वात तुमसे सत्य कह रहा हूँ

verses.sloka: न नूनम् दैवतम् किम्चित् कालेन बलवत्तरम् ।यत्र दाशरथी रामो भूमाउ एवम् शयीत सः ॥२-८८-११॥
verses.transliteration: na nūnam daivatam kimcit kālena balavattaram ।yatra dāśarathī rāmo bhūmāu evam śayīta saḥ ॥2-88-11॥

translations.english: Dasaratha's son, Rama had to rest on the ground would admittedly mean that no divine power is mightier than Time (Destiny).
translations.hindi: भरत जी के यह६बचन धुन, गुह प्रसन्न.हो गया और प्रसन्न हो, पुनः भरत जी।से कहने:लगा

verses.sloka: विदेह राजस्य सुता सीता च प्रिय दर्शना ।दयिता शयिता भूमौ स्नुषा दशरथस्य च ॥२-८८-१२॥
verses.transliteration: videha rājasya sutā sītā ca priya darśanā ।dayitā śayitā bhūmau snuṣā daśarathasya ca ॥2-88-12॥

translations.english: Sita, daughter of Janaka, king of Videha, and beloved daughterinlaw of Dasaratha who caused delight to the beholder, too had to rest on the bare ground.
translations.hindi: हे भरत ! आप धन्य हैं। आपके समान इस धराधाम पर मुझे दूसरा कोई मनुष्य नहीं देख पड़ता। क्योकि, आप बिना प्रयत्न किए हाथ लगे हुए राज्य का त्याग करना चाहते हैं

verses.sloka: इयम् शय्या मम भ्रातुर् इदम् हि परिवर्तितम् ।स्थण्डिले कठिने सर्वम् गात्रैर् विमृदितम् तृणम् ॥२-८८-१३॥
verses.transliteration: iyam śayyā mama bhrātur idam hi parivartitam ।sthaṇḍile kaṭhine sarvam gātrair vimṛditam tṛṇam ॥2-88-13॥

translations.english: This is my brother's couch and it is here where he had tossed about. The grass spread on this hard surface is crushed by his limbs.
translations.hindi: निश्चय ही आपकी यह्‌ कीर्ति सदा इस लोक में बनी! रहेंगी । क्योंकि आप कष्ट पाते हुए श्रीराम को लौटा लानो चाहते हैं

verses.sloka: मन्ये साभरणा सुप्ता सीता अस्मिन् शयने तदा ।तत्र तत्र हि दृश्यन्ते सक्ताः कनक बिन्दवः ॥२-८८-१४॥
verses.transliteration: manye sābharaṇā suptā sītā asmin śayane tadā ।tatra tatra hi dṛśyante saktāḥ kanaka bindavaḥ ॥2-88-14॥

translations.english: Some particles of gold dust are seen stuck to this bed here and there. I think Sita might have rested on this excellent bed with all her jewellery.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार शुद्द की भरत से बात चीत हो रही थी कि, इतने में सूयं का प्रकाश मन्द पड़ गया ( अर्थात्‌ सुय अस्त हो गए ) ओर रात हो गई

verses.sloka: उत्तरीयम् इह आसक्तम् सुव्यक्तम् सीतया तदा ।तथा ह्य् एते प्रकाशन्ते सक्ताः कौशेय तन्तवः ॥२-८८-१५॥
verses.transliteration: uttarīyam iha āsaktam suvyaktam sītayā tadā ।tathā hy ete prakāśante saktāḥ kauśeya tantavaḥ ॥2-88-15॥

translations.english: That the upper garment of Sita might have been caught here is well evident from the shining silken threads stuck.
translations.hindi: गह की बातचीत और खातिरदारी से सन्तुष्ट हो अरत जी अपनी सेना को टिका कर, शत्रन्न सहित पुनः लेटने को चले गए

verses.sloka: मन्ये भर्तुः सुखा शय्या येन बाला तपस्विनी ।सुकुमारी सती दुह्खम् न विजानाति मैथिली ॥२-८८-१६॥
verses.transliteration: manye bhartuḥ sukhā śayyā yena bālā tapasvinī ।sukumārī satī duhkham na vijānāti maithilī ॥2-88-16॥

translations.english: Hapless Sita is young and delicate. Being a chaste lady, she, even in these (adverse) circumstances, does not feel the brunt. Hence, maybe she thinks her husbands' (hard) bed comfortable to her.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--“शयनं पुनरागमत्‌” से जान पड़ता है कि, गुह से भेट करने के पूव भी भरत जी लेटे हुए आराम कर रहे थे । ] रामचिन्तामयः शोको भरतस्य महात्मनः? । उपस्थितो ह्यनहस्यः धम प्रेक्षस्यर ताइशः४

verses.sloka: हा हन्तास्मि नृशम्सोऽहम् यत्सभार्यः कृतेमम ।ईदृशीं राघवः शय्यामधिशेते ह्यानाथवत् ॥२-८८-१७॥
verses.transliteration: hā hantāsmi nṛśamso'ham yatsabhāryaḥ kṛtemama ।īdṛśīṁ rāghavaḥ śayyāmadhiśete hyānāthavat ॥2-88-17॥

translations.english: Alas, what suffering Because of a cruel man like me Rama along with his spouse was condemned to recline upon such bed like an orphan.
translations.hindi: महात्मनः--महाधीरस्वापि | ( गो० ) _२श्रनहंस्य- नशाक- योग्यस्य । ( शि० ) ३ धमंप्र छ्ृस्य- शाकमूलपापशून्यस्य । ( गो० ) ४ ताइशः--श्रतिदुस्सहः । ( शि० ) -५ सन्तप्तं-शुष्कं । ( गो० ) ६ गूदोऽग्निरिव--कोटराग्निरिब । ( गो» ओर वह शोकरूपों आग भरत जी को भीतर ही भीतर उसी प्रकार दर्थ करने लगी, जिस प्रकार सूखे पेड़ों को उनके खोड़र का वनाग्नि दग्ध करता है

verses.sloka: सार्वभौम कुले जातः सर्व लोक सुख आवहः ।सर्व लोक प्रियः त्यक्त्वा राज्यम् प्रियम् अनुत्तमम् ॥२-८८-१८॥
verses.transliteration: sārvabhauma kule jātaḥ sarva loka sukha āvahaḥ ।sarva loka priyaḥ tyaktvā rājyam priyam anuttamam ॥2-88-18॥

translations.english: How could such Rama sleep on the ground? He was born in the house of emperors, worthy of reverence by the entire world and beloved of all the worlds, with the complexion of a blue lotus, with red eyes, and pleasing looks, one who deserves to be happy and not to suffer by renouncing the kingdom and excellent comforts.
translations.hindi: शोकाग्नि से उत्पन्न पसीना, भरत जी के सारे शरीर से उसी प्रकार निकलने लगा, जिस प्रकार सूर्य की गर्मी से पिघल कर हिमालय से बर्फ गिरता है

verses.sloka: कथम् इन्दीवर श्यामो रक्त अक्षः प्रिय दर्शनः ।सुख भागी च दुह्ख अर्हः शयितो भुवि राघवः ॥२-८८-१९॥
verses.transliteration: katham indīvara śyāmo rakta akṣaḥ priya darśanaḥ ।sukha bhāgī ca duhkha arhaḥ śayito bhuvi rāghavaḥ ॥2-88-19॥

translations.english: How could such Rama sleep on the ground? He was born in the house of emperors, worthy of reverence by the entire world and beloved of all the worlds, with the complexion of a blue lotus, with red eyes, and pleasing looks, one who deserves to be happy and not to suffer by renouncing the kingdom and excellent comforts.

verses.sloka: धन्यः खलु महाभागो लक्ष्मणः शुभलक्षमणः ।भ्रातरम् विषमे काले यो राममनुवर्तते ॥२-८८-२०॥
verses.transliteration: dhanyaḥ khalu mahābhāgo lakṣmaṇaḥ śubhalakṣamaṇaḥ ।bhrātaram viṣame kāle yo rāmamanuvartate ॥2-88-20॥

translations.english: Surely Lakshmana of great merit and auspicious virtues is fortunate since he is accompanying his brother Rama in times of adversity.
translations.hindi: भरत के शोक रूपी पर्वत की, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का उत्सुकता पूर्वक ध्यान हो मानों छिद्ररहित शिलाए हैं, वार्त्रार लिये हुए दीघे.श्वास मानों गेरू आदि की धाराएं हैं, दीनता मानों पेड़ों का समूह है और शोक से उत्पन्न हुई मन की थकावट, मानों उस पर्वत के श्वङ्ग ( चोटियाँ ) हैं ॥ १६.॥ प्रमोहानन्तसच्वेनर सन्तापौषधिवेणुना । आक्रान्तो दुःखशैलेन महता केकयीसुतः

verses.sloka: सिद्ध अर्था खलु वैदेही पतिम् या अनुगता वनम् ।वयम् सम्शयिताः सर्वे हीनाः तेन महात्मना ॥२-८८-२१॥
verses.transliteration: siddha arthā khalu vaidehī patim yā anugatā vanam ।vayam samśayitāḥ sarve hīnāḥ tena mahātmanā ॥2-88-21॥

translations.english: Sita has, indeed, accomplished her object by accompanying her husband (to the forest). Bereft of that magnanimous Rama, all of us are in doubt (if he will accept our services).
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार भरत जी के ऊपर बड़ी भारी विपत्ति आई है । वे ऊ ची साँसें लेने लगे और बहुत उदास हो गए। डनको अपने शरीर की सुध न रही । वे मानसिक शोकज्बर से अत्यन्त पीड़ित थे । वे, अपनी हेड़ से बिछुड़े हुए बेल की तरह, किसी प्रकार भी शान्ति न पा सके

verses.sloka: अकर्ण धारा पृथिवी शून्या इव प्रतिभाति मा ।गते दशरथे स्वर्गे रामे च अरण्यम् आश्रिते ॥२-८८-२२॥
verses.transliteration: akarṇa dhārā pṛthivī śūnyā iva pratibhāti mā ।gate daśarathe svarge rāme ca araṇyam āśrite ॥2-88-22॥

translations.english: King Dasaratha having ascended to heaven and Rama taken shelter in the forest, this kingdom appears to me like a ship without a helmsman.
translations.hindi: इंति।पब्वाशोतितमः सरः ॥ गुह से आलगन किए हुए भरत को, जो श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के बनगमन के कारण बहुत उदास थे, अपने भाईबंदों सहित एकाग्र- चित्त हो, गुह ने पुनः धीरे धीरे समकाया

verses.sloka: न च प्रार्थयते कश्चिन् मनसा अपि वसुम्धराम् ।वने अपि वसतः तस्य बाहु वीर्य अभिरक्षिताम् ॥२-८८-२३॥
verses.transliteration: na ca prārthayate kaścin manasā api vasumdharām ।vane api vasataḥ tasya bāhu vīrya abhirakṣitām ॥2-88-23॥

translations.english: No one, even in thought, would ever desire this kingdom, protected by the strength of his arms even while residing in the forest.

verses.sloka: शून्य सम्वरणा रक्षाम् अयन्त्रित हय द्विपाम् ।अपावृत पुर द्वाराम् राज धानीम् अरक्षिताम् ॥२-८८-२४॥
verses.transliteration: śūnya samvaraṇā rakṣām ayantrita haya dvipām ।apāvṛta pura dvārām rāja dhānīm arakṣitām ॥2-88-24॥

translations.english: Now the gates of our capital city (Ayodhya) are wide open. The city is unprotected and endangered. There are no guards to keep vigil over the ramparts. The horses and elephants are not in control (hence unprepared for battle). The army is unhappy and demoralised. At this state even the enemies will not like to seize the city, they will shun it like food mixed with poison.

verses.sloka: अप्रहृष्ट बलाम् न्यूनाम् विषमस्थाम् अनावृताम् ।शत्रवो न अभिमन्यन्ते भक्ष्यान् विष कृतान् इव ॥२-८८-२५॥
verses.transliteration: aprahṛṣṭa balām nyūnām viṣamasthām anāvṛtām ।śatravo na abhimanyante bhakṣyān viṣa kṛtān iva ॥2-88-25॥

translations.english: Now the gates of our capital city (Ayodhya) are wide open. The city is unprotected and endangered. There are no guards to keep vigil over the ramparts. The horses and elephants are not in control (hence unprepared for battle). The army is unhappy and demoralised. At this state even the enemies will not like to seize the city, they will shun it like food mixed with poison.

verses.sloka: अद्य प्रभृति भूमौ तु शयिष्ये अहम् तृणेषु वा ।फल मूल अशनो नित्यम् जटा चीराणि धारयन् ॥२-८८-२६॥
verses.transliteration: adya prabhṛti bhūmau tu śayiṣye aham tṛṇeṣu vā ।phala mūla aśano nityam jaṭā cīrāṇi dhārayan ॥2-88-26॥

translations.english: From today onwards, wearing matted hair and clad in robes made of bark and living on fruits and roots, I too shall sleep on the naked ground or on grass.

verses.sloka: तस्य अर्थम् उत्तरम् कालम् निवत्स्यामि सुखम् वने ।तम् प्रतिश्रवम् आमुच्य न अस्य मिथ्या भविष्यति ॥२-८८-२७॥
verses.transliteration: tasya artham uttaram kālam nivatsyāmi sukham vane ।tam pratiśravam āmucya na asya mithyā bhaviṣyati ॥2-88-27॥

translations.english: Taking upon myself the vow of Rama, I too shall live in the forest cheerfully for the rest of the term on behalf of him so that his vow shall not prove untrue.

verses.sloka: वसन्तम् भ्रातुर् अर्थाय शत्रुघ्नो मा अनुवत्स्यति ।लक्ष्मणेन सह तु आर्यो अयोध्याम् पालयिष्यति ॥२-८८-२८॥
verses.transliteration: vasantam bhrātur arthāya śatrughno mā anuvatsyati ।lakṣmaṇena saha tu āryo ayodhyām pālayiṣyati ॥2-88-28॥

translations.english: As I live in the forest on behalf of my brother Rama, Satrughna will live with me. My esteemed brother Rama will rule Ayodhya along with Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: अभिषेक्ष्यन्ति काकुत्स्थम् अयोध्यायाम् द्विजातयः ।अपि मे देवताः कुर्युर् इमम् सत्यम् मनो रथम् ।प्रसाद्यमानः शिरसा मया स्वयम् ।बहु प्रकारम् यदि न प्रपत्स्यते ॥२-८८-२९॥
verses.transliteration: abhiṣekṣyanti kākutstham ayodhyāyām dvijātayaḥ ।api me devatāḥ kuryur imam satyam mano ratham ।prasādyamānaḥ śirasā mayā svayam ।bahu prakāram yadi na prapatsyate ॥2-88-29॥

translations.english: In Ayodhya the brahmins shall coronate Rama. Will the gods make this desire of mine true?

verses.sloka: ततोन्रुवत्सयामि चिराय राघवम् ।वनेचरम् नह्रुति माम्रुपेक्षित्रुम् ॥२-८८-३०॥
verses.transliteration: tatonruvatsayāmi cirāya rāghavam ।vanecaram nahruti māmrupekṣitrum ॥2-88-30॥

translations.english: I will seek his grace in many ways by bowing down my head. Even then if Rama does not grant my wish, I shall also live with him as long as it takes. He will not be able to ignore a forester like me. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टाशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightyeigth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
